kashika: नञ् समर्थेन सुबन्तेन सह समस्यते, तत्पुरुषश्च समासो भवति। न ब्राह्मणः, अब्राह्मणः। अवृषलः॥
kashikaEnglish: The negative नञ् compounds with a case-ending word: अब्राह्मणः 'non-Brahmin'. नञ् has six senses: resemblance, absence, difference, smallness, unfitness, contrariety.
englishFull:
The negative particle नञ् compounds with a connected case-inflected word to form तत्पुरुष.

**Examples:**
| Compound | Meaning |
|----------|---------|
| अब्राह्मणः | "non-brāhmaṇa" (a man, but not a brāhmaṇa) |
| अश्वेतः | "non-white" |

The म् of न is elided by @ref[6.3.73].

@note[The न् is also elided before verbs when censure is implied.]
